Maa Shailputri.hook: Navratri ka pehla din... Maa Shailputri ka aashirwaad aapke ghar aaye
Maa Shailputri.lesson: Maa Shailputri Himalaya ki beti hain, Parvati ka pehla roop. Nandi par virajman, haath mein trishul aur kamal.
Maa Shailputri.real_life: Maa se maango majboot neev: jo kaam shuru karo, poore vishwas se shuru karo.

Maa Brahmacharini.hook: Navratri ka doosra din... Maa Brahmacharini aapko dhairya ka aashirwaad dein
Maa Brahmacharini.lesson: Maa Brahmacharini tap aur sanyam ka roop hain. Ek haath mein mala, doosre mein kamandal.
Maa Brahmacharini.real_life: Mehnat aur sabr ka phal zaroor milta hai: aaj bhi koshish mat chhodna.

Maa Chandraghanta.hook: Navratri ka teesra din... Maa Chandraghanta aapke saare dar door karein
Maa Chandraghanta.lesson: Maa Chandraghanta ke mathe par ardhchandra aur ghanta hai. Sher par sawar, bhakton ka bhay door karti hain.
Maa Chandraghanta.real_life: Dar ko door rakho aur himmat se aage badho: Maa saath hain.

Maa Kushmanda.hook: Navratri ka chautha din... Maa Kushmanda aapko sehat aur khushi dein
Maa Kushmanda.lesson: Maa Kushmanda ne apni halki muskaan se brahmand ki rachna ki. Ashtabhuja roop, sher ki sawari.
Maa Kushmanda.real_life: Muskurao, kyunki muskaan se hi roshni phailti hai: aaj sabko ek muskaan do.

Maa Skandamata.hook: Navratri ka paanchva din... Maa Skandamata ki mamta aap par barse
Maa Skandamata.lesson: Maa Skandamata bhagwan Kartikeya, yaani Skand, ki mata hain. Kamal par virajman, god mein baal Skand.
Maa Skandamata.real_life: Maa ki mamta sabse badi shakti hai: aaj apni maa ko ek phone zaroor karo.

Maa Katyayani.hook: Navratri ka chhata din... Maa Katyayani aapko himmat ka aashirwaad dein
Maa Katyayani.lesson: Maa Katyayani rishi Katyayan ki putri hain, jinhone Mahishasur ka vadh kiya. Himmat aur shakti ka roop.
Maa Katyayani.real_life: Sach ke liye khade hona seekho: sahi baat par himmat se tik jao.

Maa Kalaratri.hook: Navratri ka saatva din... Maa Kalaratri andhere ko door karein
Maa Kalaratri.lesson: Maa Kalaratri ka roop bhayankar hai, par wo hamesha bhakton ka shubh karti hain, isliye Shubhankari kahlati hain.
Maa Kalaratri.real_life: Andhera kitna bhi gehra ho, subah zaroor hoti hai: hausla rakho.

Maa Mahagauri.hook: Navratri ka aathva din... Maa Mahagauri aapke jeevan mein shanti layein
Maa Mahagauri.lesson: Maa Mahagauri shwet varn ki hain, bail par sawar. Unki pooja se mann ki shuddhi aur shanti milti hai.
Maa Mahagauri.real_life: Mann saaf rakho, sab saaf ho jayega: aaj kisi ko maaf kar do.

Maa Siddhidatri.hook: Navratri ka navva din... Maa Siddhidatri aapki har icchha poori karein
Maa Siddhidatri.lesson: Maa Siddhidatri kamal par virajman hain aur bhakton ko siddhiyan aur gyaan deti hain.
Maa Siddhidatri.real_life: Seekhna kabhi band mat karo: gyaan hi sabse badi siddhi hai.

Maa Mahagauri aur Maa Siddhidatri.hook: Ashtami aur Navami... Maa Mahagauri aur Maa Siddhidatri ka aashirwaad aap par rahe
Maa Mahagauri aur Maa Siddhidatri.lesson: Maa Mahagauri shanti aur shuddhi deti hain, Maa Siddhidatri gyaan aur siddhi. Dono roop Navratri ka samapan hain.
Maa Mahagauri aur Maa Siddhidatri.real_life: Mann saaf, soch badi: aaj kuch naya seekhne ka sankalp lo.

Shiv ji.hook: Somvaar ki subah... Mahadev ka aashirwaad aapke saath rahe
Shiv ji.lesson: Bhagwan Shiv shant, saral aur bholenath hain. Gangadhari, Neelkanth, jo bhakti se hi prasann ho jaate hain.
Shiv ji.real_life: Shiv jaise shant raho: gussa kam, dhairya zyada, aur dil bada.
Shiv ji.head: HAR HAR MAHADEV
Shiv ji.cta: Har Har Mahadev, family ko bhejo

Hanuman ji.hook: Mangalvaar ki subah... Bajrangbali aapke saare sankat harein
Hanuman ji.lesson: Hanuman ji shakti, bhakti aur nishtha ke prateek hain. Shri Ram ke param bhakt, sankat mochan.
Hanuman ji.real_life: Bhakti aur mehnat saath chalein toh koi mushkil bada nahi: aaj ek mushkil kaam pehle karo.
Hanuman ji.head: JAI HANUMAN

Ganesh ji.hook: Budhvaar ki subah... Ganpati Bappa aapke raaste ke vighna door karein
Ganesh ji.lesson: Ganesh ji vighnaharta hain aur har shubh kaam ki shuruaat unse hoti hai. Buddhi aur samriddhi ke daata.
Ganesh ji.real_life: Naye din ki shuruaat Bappa ke naam se: aaj ek adhoora kaam poora kar do.
Ganesh ji.head: GANPATI BAPPA
Ganesh ji.cta: Ganpati Bappa Morya, family ko bhejo

Vishnu ji.hook: Guruvaar ki subah... Bhagwan Vishnu ka aashirwaad aap par bana rahe
Vishnu ji.lesson: Bhagwan Vishnu sansar ke paalanhaar hain. Sheshnag par virajman, Maa Lakshmi ke saath, sabka santulan banate hain.
Vishnu ji.real_life: Santulan banao: kaam, family aur apne liye, teeno ko thoda waqt do.
Vishnu ji.head: JAI SHRI HARI
Vishnu ji.cta: Jai Shri Hari, family ko bhejo

Maa Lakshmi.hook: Shukravaar ki subah... Maa Lakshmi aapke ghar sukh aur samriddhi layein
Maa Lakshmi.lesson: Maa Lakshmi dhan, sukh aur samriddhi ki devi hain. Kamal par virajman, unke haath se sone ke sikke barastein hain.
Maa Lakshmi.real_life: Imaandari aur mehnat hi sachi Lakshmi hai: aaj apni kamai ka ek hissa kisi ke kaam aaye.
Maa Lakshmi.head: JAI MAA LAKSHMI
Maa Lakshmi.cta: Jai Maa Lakshmi, family ko bhejo

Shani Dev.hook: Shanivaar ki subah... Shani Dev aapko sahi raah par chalne ka bal dein
Shani Dev.lesson: Shani Dev nyay aur karm ke devta hain. Wo har kisi ko uske karm ka phal dete hain.
Shani Dev.real_life: Acche karm karo, baaki sab Shani Dev par chhod do: aaj ek acha kaam zaroor karo.
Shani Dev.head: JAI SHANI DEV
Shani Dev.cta: Jai Shani Dev, family ko bhejo

Surya Dev.hook: Ravivaar ki subah... Surya Dev ki roshni aapke jeevan mein ujala layein
Surya Dev.lesson: Surya Dev jeevan ke daata hain. Saat ashwon ke rath par sawar, har subah duniya mein roshni laate hain.
Surya Dev.real_life: Suraj ki tarah roz waqt par uthna: aaj ke din ko roshni se shuru karo.
Surya Dev.head: JAI SURYA DEV
Surya Dev.cta: Jai Surya Dev, family ko bhejo

Ram ji.hook: Shubh tyohaar... Prabhu Shri Ram ka aashirwaad aapke saath rahe
Ram ji.lesson: Shri Ram maryada purushottam hain. Unka jeevan sach, vachan aur kartavya ka sandesh deta hai.
Ram ji.real_life: Apna vachan nibhao aur sach ke saath khade raho: yahi Ram ka raasta hai.
Ram ji.head: JAI SHRI RAM
Ram ji.cta: Jai Shri Ram, family ko bhejo

Krishna ji.hook: Shubh tyohaar... Shri Krishna ka aashirwaad aap par barse
Krishna ji.lesson: Shri Krishna Geeta ke updeshak hain: karm karo, phal ki chinta mat karo.
Krishna ji.real_life: Kaam par dhyan do, natije ki fikr chhodo: aaj apna best do.
Krishna ji.head: JAI SHRI KRISHNA
Krishna ji.cta: Jai Shri Krishna, family ko bhejo

navratri_common.head: SHUBH NAVRATRI
navratri_common.cta: Jai Mata Di, family ko bhejo

defaults.pin: Apni family ko bhejo, unka din ban jayega 🙏
